rollback_rehearsal.action: AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_DISABLED=<backend> in the swarm tick environment routes new spawns to the local adapter; existing attempt records keep their runtime_backend and their operations return unavailable
rollback_rehearsal.case: c: a disabled remote left its attempt record and runtime object unchanged, a new spawn went local, and after re-enabling a replayed spawn reached only the owning remote, which returned the first object without a duplicate

remaining_limitations: Replay deduplication is the owning backend's: the router forwards a replayed spawn to its owner and adds no second backend; reconciliation by immutable execution ID (INV-R06) and generation fencing (INV-R07) are not implemented here.
